Deprecated: dh_autotools-dev_updateconfig and dh_autotools-dev_restoreconfig are deprecated and replaced by dh_update_autotools_config(1) and dh_clean(1) from debhelper. Please replace all uses of dh_autotools-dev_updateconfig with dh_update_autotools_config and then remove any use of dh_autotools-dev_restoreconfig.

dh_autotools-dev_restoreconfig restores the original config.sub and config.guess files that have been backed up by dh_autotools-dev_updateconfig under the names config.sub.dh-orig and config.guess.dh-orig.

dh_autotools-dev_restoreconfig is usually called indirectly in a rules file via the dh command.

        %:
                dh $@ --with autotools_dev

It can also be direcly called in the clean rule.

        clean:
                dh_testdir
                dh_testroot
                [ ! -f Makefile ] || $(MAKE) clean
                dh_autotools-dev_restoreconfig
                dh_clean

debhelper(7), dh(1).

This program is meant to be used together with debhelper.
